engine: gapsystudio's team carousel — a row of PORTRAIT cards (people / avatars), SEVERAL visible at once (perView), that translateX one card at a time. Under each card a NAME + ROLE caption. Below the row a horizontal PROGRESS-LINE whose filled segment (scaleX) tracks the scroll position, flanked by round prev/next arrows. Driven by arrows, drag, wheel, keyboard. Harvested from D_gapsy (C /about — Albina/Katya/Olena 'UI/UX Designer' + a progress line).

measured_teardown.move: track translateX(-index * step)px, step = card width + gap. perView cards visible at once (each card flex 0 0 calc((100% - (perView-1)*gap)/perView)); maxIdx = count - perView, so you can't scroll past the last full view. The progress-fill scaleX = index / maxIdx (transform-origin left). Active cards (the visible window) are full; off-window cards scale .97 + dim .82. ease ~cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) ~520ms. Arrows disable at idx 0 / maxIdx.
measured_teardown.cited: gapsy /about: portrait cards (3D-avatar images), several visible, name + role ('UI/UX Designer') under each; a horizontal progress line with left/right arrows below.

perView.what: how many cards are visible at once; card width = 1/perView of the viewport (minus gaps). maxIdx = count - perView.

wheel.what: advance on horizontal wheel intent (or shift+wheel); one step per gesture.

drag.what: pointer drag / swipe (threshold max(40px, 18% of a card)); move/up on WINDOW (F-08).

entry: AvatarCardCarousel.create(target, opts) -> { go(i), next(), prev(), index(), count, destroy }. target = .acc-stage > .acc-viewport > .acc-track > .acc-card(.acc-media img + .acc-name + .acc-role) + .acc-prev/.acc-next + .acc-progress(.acc-progress-fill). go(i) clamps to [0, maxIdx].
law: transform: translateX (track) + scaleX (progress fill) + scale (off-window cards) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the cards; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant index. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a triggered carousel). Drag move/up/cancel on WINDOW (F-08). Keyboard Left/Right step.
gate_mode: triggered (arrows / drag / wheel / keyboard), NOT scroll. Verify: perView cards visible; step = cardW + gap; progress-fill scaleX = idx/maxIdx; arrows disable at 0 and maxIdx (no scroll past the last full view). Distinct from horizontal-spec-carousel (one landscape card + edge-peek + spec-row): here MANY portrait cards + name/role caption + a progress-line. Smoothness via the TRIGGERED probe.
proven: lab: 5 team cards (perView 3) on OUR QUADRO renders, name+role under each. Measured live: idx0 tx=0 fill=0.00 activeCount=3 prevDisabled; next -> idx1 tx=-430 fill=0.50; at-max -> idx2 tx=-861 fill=1.00 nextDisabled; prev -> idx1 fill=0.50. step = 430px = cardW 406 + gap 24; 3 cards always active; maxIdx=2 (count 5 - perView 3). Progress-fill scaleX tracks idx/maxIdx exactly.
